findings.claim: Eaton FY2025 10-K 揭露 2025、2024、2023 年皆無單一客戶占淨銷售超過 10%。
findings.excerpt: Other Information No single customer represented greater than 10% of net sales in 2025, 2024 or 2023, respectively.
